title: Pipeline output
description: What the scoring pipeline is actually producing: pool tiering, rollup freshness and signals emitted. Queried straight from Timescale, since none of this is exported to Prometheus.

options.content: This dashboard reads Postgres/Timescale directly (pools, pool_metrics_5m/10m, signals) rather than Prometheus, because the scorer does not export any of this as metrics yet. Indicator computation timing is left out entirely: nothing in the schema or the metrics registry records how long an indicator pass takes, so there is no real data to show for it. Adding that would mean a duration histogram registered in libraries/metrics and timed calls around the indicator worker.

panels.title: Pools by tier
panels.description: pools.tier: 0 = universe (screened only), 1 = watched (bin state subscribed).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE tier WHEN 0 THEN 'universe (tier 0)' WHEN 1 THEN 'watched (tier 1)' ELSE tier::text END AS tier, count(*) AS pools FROM pools GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier;

panels.title: Seconds since last 5m rollup bucket
panels.description: How stale pool_metrics_5m is. The rollup worker writes a bucket every 5 minutes; a value climbing well past that means the rollup tick has stopped running.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(bucket_start)))::bigint AS seconds_since_last_bucket FROM pool_metrics_5m;

panels.title: Seconds since last 10m rollup bucket
panels.description: How stale pool_metrics_10m is. Written every 10 minutes for tier-1 pools (rolled up) and tier-0 pools (native resolution).

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM (now() - max(bucket.bucket_start)))::bigint AS seconds_since_last_bucket FROM pool_metrics_10m bucket;
SELECT count(*) AS signals FROM signals WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours';

panels.title: Pools with an indicator row (last 1h)
panels.description: Distinct pools with at least one indicators_5m row in the last hour -- a cross-check that the indicator worker is producing output, independent of timing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT pool_address) AS pools FROM indicators_5m WHERE bucket_start > now() - interval '1 hour';

panels.title: Signals emitted by kind
panels.description: signals.kind over time (POTENTIAL / DEGRADING / GATE_FAIL / INFO), bucketed in 15-minute windows.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('15 minutes', ts) AS "time", kind, count(*) AS signals FROM signals WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;
